hypothesis: Cost is predominantly fixed scheduler admission overhead, with variation from priority-queue insertion and container growth.

pcvs.name: waiting_depth
pcvs.rationale: Captures queue-size-dependent insertion and container growth costs.

pcvs.name: heap_height
pcvs.rationale: Computes heap height over the bounded workload using comparisons.

pcvs.name: highest_priority
pcvs.rationale: Highest-priority requests can traverse more heap levels during insertion.

pcvs.name: empty_waiting_queue
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes initial admission into an empty queue.
